<DESCRIPTION>EXTENSION AGREEMENT, DATED OCTOBER 12, 2026, BY AND BETWEEN QUALSTAR CORPORATION AND STEVEN N. BRONSON.

<DIV style=margin-left:72pt;width:468pt><P align=right style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Exhibit 10.2</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>EXTENSION AGREEMENT</B></P>
<P align=center style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Reference is made to the Employment Agreement dated as of February 1, 2024 (the &#8220;<B><I>Employment Agreement</I></B>&#8221;) by and between Qualstar Corporation, a Nevada corporation (&#8220;<B><I>Qualstar</I></B>&#8221;), and Steven N. Bronson, its Chief Executive Officer and President (&#8220;<B><I>Executive</I></B>&#8221;). &nbsp;Capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the respective meanings ascribed thereto in the Employment Agreement.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>WHEREAS</B>, by its terms the Employment Agreement expired on January 31, 2026;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>WHEREAS</B>, notwithstanding such expiration, Executive has continued to perform in the same capacities;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the foregoing, the parties agree that:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0;text-indent:-18pt;margin-left:36pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-18pt'>1.</KBD>The expiration date of the Employment Agreement shall be extended to January 31, 2027; and&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-18pt'>2.</KBD>Except as set forth herein, the Employment Agreement shall remain in full force and effect and shall be deemed for all purposes to have been in continuous effect since its original execution date.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:36pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>IN WITNESS WHEREOF</B>, the parties have executed this Extension Agreement as of October 12, 2026.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
